_comment: Acceptance criteria with no manual home, and why. Every criterion is either anchored in a manual page with an '<!-- ac: -->' comment, or listed here. 'omitted-internal' means it has no user-visible behaviour. 'omitted-unshipped' means the behaviour is not reachable in the shipped product. 'todo' means it belongs in the manual but the page is not written yet.

omitted-unshipped.reason: Input mode is unreachable: 'inputMode' is absent from AUDIO_SYNC_KEYS, so no patch or preset load ever sends it, and no control sets it.
Same unreachable input-mode path.
Same unreachable input-mode path.
Bounds a mode change nothing can trigger.
Directional family-voicing separation is not delivered; the shipped test asserts the inverse and records it as a known gap.
No modular rig editor. The patch is still fixed pre/post pedal arrays.
No graph to migrate to.
The engine runs a hardcoded chain; there is no compiled graph plan.
No routing graph exists.
The bridge sends fixed parameter names, not graph-aware ones.
Only four chain pedal types are reachable; no eq, amp, cab, IR-loader, gain, split, or merge blocks.
Only reorder and bypass on fixed slots. No create, duplicate, delete, solo, rename, or move.
Routing is a four-value preset; there is no split node or per-lane level and pan.
Dual-amp blends before the output, but the second branch is derived rather than independent.
No macro field or assignment exists.
Snapshots ship, but without the required count and without macro values.
No modular editor to disclose progressively.
No graph, so no graph validator.
Chain-order rebuild ships; the graph swap half has no subject.
No graph contract on either side.
The store holds a patch, not a graph.
No rig editor; reorder is discrete move controls.
Lookahead in beats has no control. Phrase view is fixed at four beats.
Five-zone layout is not shipped. The panel is Lineup, Phrase stage, and Quick read.
Play through Lab complexity chips are not on the shipped panel.
Play-only musical-label surface is not shipped; Phrase, Lift, Spread, Stage, and Desk are always visible.
Not every panel control is a host-automatable lane. Four descriptor lanes ship; most Phrase, Lift, Spread, Stage, and Handle fields do not.
No orchestral template loads a pre-routed section set.
No Orchestra-specific insert surface. Track inserts are the DAW mixer, not this panel.
Pad bay does not expose layers, insert FX, transient shaper, or output routing. Hit, Tone, Crunch, Level, Pan, and Bright ship.
No sample drop, zones, or round-robin control on the shipped panel.
The grid toggles steps and Alt-drags velocity. Probability, micro-timing, parameter locks, and conditionals have no editor.
Per-pad send knobs and bus routing are not on the panel. Space and Spray are kit-global mixes.
No dropped-loop auto-slice onto pads.
Play through Lab complexity levels are not on the shipped panel.
Ratchet count can appear on a step. There is no control to write it.
No pattern-morph control.
No 16 Levels mode.
No Note Repeat control.
No Fill-hold mode.
No extract-from-pattern control on Toaster.
